note: 制度・役割ガイドと役割と責任マップ（業務の分担）の文。評価の項目・配点・基準点・最低条件は careerscore/cs-q4-v1.json（Excel から）を正本として画面がそこから読む。ここは文だけ。Claude が 11/24 に Excel の評価項目と配点から作った案（Moto さんの答え 2 A・6 A・7 A）。Moto さんが確かめるまで status は draft（GM・CEO だけが「案」として見る）。公開するときは status を published にして approval に確かめた人・日・メモを書く（PR で）。 等級の位置付け（position）は Excel「配点・基準点案」52〜57・81〜86 行の文をそのまま写したもの（Moto さん 11/24 の Excel・sha256 380884c8…）。notes も同じシートの文。
gradeRange: G1〜G6（G7 は制度に入れない・Moto さん 11/24）

nextChecks.ja: OJT の習得確認（指導者が確かめる）
nextChecks.en: OJT mastery confirmed by the trainer
Base score of the current grade

nextChecks.ja: 最低条件（総合点とは別）
昇格先の仕事を実務で確かめる
nextChecks.en: Doing the next grade's work in practice

nextChecks.ja: 昇格の申請と承認（今の手順）

nextNote.ja: どれか 1 つだけで昇格はしません。OJT を終えても点数や Grade・時給・Tip Rate は自動で変わりません。
nextNote.en: No single check leads to promotion. Finishing OJT does not automatically change scores, Grade, wage or Tip Rate.

separateRules.ja: 時給・Tip Rate・賞与・福利厚生は別の決まりです（このガイドでは変えません）。
separateRules.en: Wage, Tip Rate, bonus and benefits follow separate rules (this guide does not change them).

summary.ja: 担当の持ち場で、手順とルールを守って基本の仕事を自立してできるようになる段階。
summary.en: Learn to do the basic work of your own station on your own, following procedures and rules.

scope.ja: 自分の持ち場（シフトで決まったポジション）
scope.en: Your own station (the position set for the shift)

tasks.ja: Opening・Closing を手順どおりに終え、各種リストを使って記録する
tasks.en: Finish Opening and Closing by the procedure and record them with the checklists

tasks.ja: 担当ポジションの基本（接客か仕込み・調理）を基準どおりに行う
tasks.en: Do the basics of your position (service or prep/cooking) to the standard

tasks.ja: 清潔さ・衛生・安全の基本を毎回守る
tasks.en: Keep the basics of cleanliness, hygiene and safety every time

develop.ja: わからないことは質問し、教わったことを次の仕事に活かす。
develop.en: Ask when unsure and use what you were taught in the next task.

next.ja: G2：担当の持ち場を自立して回し、周囲へ基本的な支援・指導ができること。
next.en: G2: run your station on your own and give basic support and coaching to those around you.

position.ja: 一般スタッフ：担当作業を学び、手順・品質・スピードの基準へ近づく。次のG2判定ではG2の範囲で採点。
position.en: General staff: learn your tasks and move toward the standards for procedure, quality and speed. The G2 judgment is scored on the G2 scope.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 52 行

summary.ja: 担当の持ち場を安定させ、シフトの仲間を助け、新しく入った人に手順を教える段階。
summary.en: Keep your station steady, help the shift team, and teach procedures to new staff.

scope.ja: 自分の持ち場と、同じシフトのまわりの持ち場
scope.en: Your station and the stations around it on the same shift

tasks.ja: 混んだときに自分の作業の順番を変え、遅れや不足を早めに伝える
tasks.en: Change the order of your work when busy and report delays or shortages early

tasks.ja: トラブルの初期対応をし、責任者へつなぐ
tasks.en: Handle the first response to trouble and pass it to the person in charge

tasks.ja: 新しく入った人に手順を順番に見せ、一緒にやって確かめる
tasks.en: Show new staff the procedure step by step, do it together and check

develop.ja: 教えるときは理由と完成の基準を伝え、良い行動を具体的に認める。
develop.en: When teaching, explain the reason and the finish standard, and recognize good actions specifically.

next.ja: G3：主部門の品質・段取り・人の動きを管理し、日常の業務指導・習得確認ができること。
next.en: G3: manage quality, planning and people's movement in the main department, and give day-to-day coaching and mastery checks.

position.ja: Crew Leader：担当持ち場を自立して回し、周囲へ基本的な支援・指導ができる。店舗により発注等を担う場合も評価に含む。
position.en: Crew Leader: run your station on your own and give basic support and coaching to those around you. Where a store gives you ordering and similar work, it is included in the evaluation.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 53 行

summary.ja: 主部門のリーダーとして品質・段取り・人の動きを管理し、日常の業務指導と習得確認、問題の解決を進める段階。
summary.en: As leader of the main department, manage quality, planning and people's movement, and lead day-to-day coaching, mastery checks and problem solving.

scope.ja: 主部門（Server・Kitchen）の品質・段取り・人の動き。他部門は連携と基本実務（G3 Operation Leader は両部門育成型が基本）
scope.en: Main department (Server or Kitchen): quality, planning and people's movement. Other departments: cooperation and basic work (G3 Operation Leader is basically the both-departments type)

tasks.ja: ピークの担当ポジションと作業の分担を決め、優先順位を調整する
tasks.en: Set peak positions and task split, and adjust priorities

tasks.ja: 仕込みの段取り・調理の順番・提供の流れを組み立てる
tasks.en: Plan prep, cooking order and the flow of serving

tasks.ja: 問題を見つけて解決まで進め、上長とスタッフに伝える
tasks.en: Find problems, take them to a solution, and report to managers and staff

develop.ja: 日常の指導：相手の習熟に合わせて教え、改善点を伝えて習得まで支える。
develop.en: Day-to-day coaching: teach to each person's level, give feedback and support until they master it.

next.ja: G4：接客と Kitchen の両方の実務に加え、店舗全体の QSC・人員・数字・教育を管理する準備ができていること。
next.en: G4: be ready to manage the whole store's QSC, staffing, numbers and training, besides hands-on work in both service and Kitchen.

position.ja: 部門Leader：主部門の品質・段取り・人の動きを管理し、日常の業務指導・習得確認を行う。他部門は連携と基本実務を求める。リーダー・後継者育成は昇格の必須条件にしない。
position.en: Department Leader: manage quality, planning and people's movement in your main department, and give day-to-day coaching and mastery checks. For other departments, cooperation and basic work are expected. Developing leaders and successors is not a requirement for promotion.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 54 行

summary.ja: 1 店の結果（売上・FL・品質・人）に責任を持ち、方針を行動にし、リーダーと後継者を育てる段階。
summary.en: Own one store's results (sales, FL, quality, people), turn direction into action, and develop leaders and successors.

scope.ja: 1 店（店舗全体の QSC・人員・数字・教育）
scope.en: One store (the whole store's QSC, staffing, numbers and training)

tasks.ja: 売上と繁閑を予測して人員を計画し、営業の状況に合わせて調整する
tasks.en: Forecast sales and busy times, plan staffing and adjust to the day

tasks.ja: 予算と実績の差、Food Cost・Labor を見て改善する
tasks.en: Check budget vs. actual, Food Cost and Labor, and improve

tasks.ja: 店舗 MTG を行動につなげ、改善を続く仕組みにする
tasks.en: Make store meetings lead to action and turn improvements into routines

tasks.ja: スキルと Tip Rate を基準と根拠で判断する
tasks.en: Judge skills and Tip Rate by the standard and the evidence

develop.ja: リーダーと後継者を育てる：強みと課題を捉え、任せる機会をつくる。
develop.en: Develop leaders and successors: see strengths and gaps and create chances to delegate.

next.ja: G5：複数の店を支援し、店長を育てる準備ができていること。
next.en: G5: be ready to support several stores and develop store managers.

position.ja: 店長：接客とKitchen両方の実務に加え、店舗全体のQSC・人員・数字・教育を管理し、改善を完了まで進める。リーダー・後継者の育成にも責任を持つ。
position.en: Store Manager: besides hands-on work in both service and Kitchen, manage the whole store's QSC, staffing, numbers and training, and carry improvements through to completion. Also responsible for developing leaders and successors.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 55 行

summary.ja: 管轄の店の計画と見通しを立て、店長を支援し、店長・管理者を育てる段階。
summary.en: Plan and forecast for the stores you cover, support store managers, and develop managers.

scope.ja: 管轄の店（複数店）
scope.en: The stores you cover (several stores)

tasks.ja: 現場を訪れ、数字と現場から問題の兆候を捉える
tasks.en: Visit stores and catch early signs of problems in numbers and on site

tasks.ja: 管轄の売上・FL の計画を立て、店ごとに分析して優先順位を決める
tasks.en: Plan sales and FL for your stores, analyze by store and set priorities

tasks.ja: 支援が必要な店へ人員・教育・運営の支援をし、Office・Chef とつなぐ
tasks.en: Give staffing, training and operations support where needed, and connect with Office and Chef

tasks.ja: 有効な改善をほかの店へ広げる
tasks.en: Spread effective improvements to other stores

develop.ja: 店長・管理者の評価の根拠を確かめ、評価と育成につなげる。
develop.en: Check the evidence behind managers' evaluations and connect it to their development.

next.ja: G6：全社の方向と計画に責任を持つ準備ができていること。
next.en: G6: be ready to take responsibility for company-wide direction and plans.

position.ja: 複数店舗・管轄責任：現場との信頼・店舗支援・店舗間協力を築き、管轄のKGI/KPI・FLから課題を捉えて改善を支援する。店長を育て、自立と基準の定着を確認する。店長不在店も含め、現場の責任者・スタッフが相談できる体制を整える。
position.en: Multi-store, area responsibility: build trust with the stores, store support and cooperation between stores; catch issues from the area's KGI/KPI and FL and support improvement. Develop store managers and confirm their independence and that standards take hold. Make sure leaders and staff can consult, including stores without a manager.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 56 行

summary.ja: 全社の方向・計画と見通しに責任を持ち、店・Office・Chef をつなぐ段階。
summary.en: Own company-wide direction, plans and forecasts, and connect stores, Office and Chef.

scope.ja: 全社
scope.en: The whole company

tasks.ja: 全社の売上・FL の計画と見通しを立て、店ごとの課題と優先順位を決める
tasks.en: Plan and forecast company sales and FL, and set issues and priorities by store

tasks.ja: 店をまたぐ企画と連携を進め、店どうしのつながりをつくる
tasks.en: Lead cross-store projects and cooperation, and build connections between stores

tasks.ja: 店長・管理者の評価と育成の方向を決める
tasks.en: Set the direction for evaluating and developing managers

develop.ja: 次のリーダーと管理者の成長の機会をつくる。
develop.en: Create growth chances for the next leaders and managers.

position.ja: 全社運営責任：AM等を育て、Office・Chef・現場の連携を整える。全社のKGI/KPI・FL・店別の兆候から支援を配分し、改善と楽しむ文化が続く仕組みをつくる。
position.en: Company-wide operations: develop AMs and others, and align Office, Chef and the stores. Allocate support from company KGI/KPI, FL and store-level signs, and build systems so improvement and a culture of enjoyment continue.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 57 行

duty.ja: Opening・Closing と各種リスト
トラブルの初期対応と指揮
duty.en: First response and command in trouble

note.ja: G1・G2 は初期対応、G3 はシフト、G4 は店の指揮
note.en: G1–G2 first response; G3 the shift; G4 the store

duty.ja: 接客と提供のタイミング
クレームの兆候と対応
duty.en: Signs of complaints and handling them

duty.ja: 仕込み・調理・盛り付け
仕込みの段取りと調理の順番
清潔さ・衛生・温度管理
在庫・棚卸・発注
歩留まり・ロス・商品原価
ピークの持ち場と作業の分担
人員の計画と営業中の調整
duty.en: Staffing plan and adjustment during service

duty.ja: 店舗 MTG と改善の仕組み化
duty.en: Store meetings and making improvements routine

duty.ja: 予算と実績・FL

note.ja: 責任の範囲：G4 は 1 店・G5 は管轄・G6 は全社
note.en: Scope: G4 one store; G5 covered stores; G6 the company

duty.ja: 発信・口コミ・レビュー
duty.en: Posts, word of mouth and reviews

duty.ja: お客様向けのイベント・キャンペーン
新しく入った人への手順の指導
スキルと Tip Rate の判断

note.ja: Tip Rate の決まり・承認の流れは別の決まりのまま
note.en: Tip Rate rules and approval flow stay under their own rules

duty.ja: リーダー・後継者の育成
店長・管理者の評価根拠の確認
計画・見通しと支援が必要な店への支援
duty.en: Plans, forecasts and support for stores in need

duty.ja: 他店・Office・Chef との連携と改善の展開
duty.en: Working with other stores, Office and Chef, and spreading improvements

summary.ja: 担当ポジションの仕込み・調理を、レシピと衛生の基準どおりに自立して完結する段階。
summary.en: Complete the prep and cooking of your position on your own, to the recipe and hygiene standards.

scope.ja: 自分の担当ポジション
scope.en: Your own position

tasks.ja: 担当の仕込みを準備から保管まで自立して完結する
tasks.en: Complete your prep on your own, from setup to storage

tasks.ja: レシピどおりの味・分量・盛付を再現する
tasks.en: Reproduce taste, portion and plating to the recipe

tasks.ja: 温度・保管・手洗いとアレルギー・異物の予防を毎回守る
tasks.en: Keep temperature, storage, handwashing and allergy/foreign-object prevention every time

develop.ja: わからない基準は確かめ、教わったことを次の仕込みに活かす。
develop.en: Check standards you are unsure of and use what you learned in the next prep.

next.ja: S2：複数の持ち場を担い、基礎指導や開発・原価改善の支援ができること。
next.en: S2: cover several stations, give basic coaching, and support development and cost improvement.

position.ja: 担当の仕込み・調理を自立して行う専門実務者。
position.en: A specialist who does their own prep and cooking on their own.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 81 行

summary.ja: 複数の持ち場を担って品質を安定させ、基礎の指導をしながら、開発や原価改善を支える段階。
summary.en: Cover several stations with steady quality, give basic coaching, and support development and cost improvement.

scope.ja: 複数の持ち場
scope.en: Several stations

tasks.ja: 味・食感・温度を安定させ、品質を保って基準時間内に完成する
tasks.en: Keep taste, texture and temperature steady and finish within standard time

tasks.ja: 営業開始までの準備と、閉店作業・翌日の準備を終える
tasks.en: Finish setup before opening and closing work and next-day prep

tasks.ja: 品質のずれを予防し、見つけたら直す
tasks.en: Prevent quality drift and fix it when found

develop.ja: 効率的な仕込みとレシピの分量をスタッフに教え、できたか確かめる。
develop.en: Teach efficient prep and recipe portions to staff and check they can do it.

next.ja: S3（Head Chef の目安）：担当店の技術・品質・開発・原価改善と日常の技術指導・習得確認を担えること。
next.en: S3 (Head Chef guide): take on the store's technique, quality, development and cost improvement, and day-to-day technical coaching and mastery checks.

position.ja: 複数持ち場を担い、基礎指導・開発や原価改善を支援。
position.en: Covers several stations, gives basic coaching, and supports product development and cost improvement.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 82 行

summary.ja: 担当店の厨房（技術・品質・開発・原価改善）に責任を持ち、日常の技術指導と習得確認をする段階（Head Chef の目安・G3 Kitchen Leader と協力）。
summary.en: Own the store kitchen (technique, quality, development, cost improvement) and give day-to-day technical coaching and mastery checks (Head Chef guide; works with the G3 Kitchen Leader).

scope.ja: 担当店の厨房（技術・品質・開発・原価改善）
scope.en: The store kitchen (technique, quality, development, cost improvement)

tasks.ja: 必要量と完成時刻から Prep の工程と分担を組む
tasks.en: Plan Prep processes and task split from quantities and finish times

tasks.ja: レシピの原価を計算し、歩留まりを設計に入れる
tasks.en: Calculate recipe cost and build yield into the design

tasks.ja: 仕込み負担と提供時間を考えて商品を設計する
tasks.en: Design products with prep load and serving time in mind

tasks.ja: 発注・在庫・棚卸を回す
tasks.en: Run ordering, inventory and stocktaking

develop.ja: スタッフの仕込みの習熟を把握し、次の目標を決めて習得を確かめる。
develop.en: Know each staff member's prep skill, set the next goal and confirm mastery.

next.ja: S4：会社全体の商品開発・原価改善・リーダー育成を主導できること。
next.en: S4: lead company-wide product development, cost improvement and leader development.

position.ja: Head Chefの目安。担当店の技術・品質・開発・原価改善と日常の技術指導・習得確認を担う。同格のG3 Kitchen Leaderと協力する。
position.en: Guide level for Head Chef. Responsible for the store's technique, quality, development and cost improvement, and day-to-day technical coaching and mastery checks. Works with the G3 Kitchen Leader of the same level.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 83 行

summary.ja: 会社全体の商品開発・原価改善・リーダー育成を主導する段階（S4 から Kitchen Leader の育成を含む）。
summary.en: Lead company-wide product development, cost improvement and leader development (from S4, includes developing Kitchen Leaders).

scope.ja: 会社全体の厨房（商品・原価・衛生）
scope.en: Company kitchens (products, cost, hygiene)

tasks.ja: 季節とお客様の好みから新商品をつくり、メニューを定期的に見直す
tasks.en: Create new products from season and guest preferences, and review menus regularly

tasks.ja: Food Cost の実績と変動を把握し、原価改善を実行して検証する
tasks.en: Track Food Cost and its changes, and carry out and verify cost improvements

tasks.ja: 衛生事故に備え、起きたとき・疑いがあるときに対応する
tasks.en: Prepare for food-safety incidents and respond when one happens or is suspected

develop.ja: Kitchen Leader の判断力・指導力を育てる。
develop.en: Develop Kitchen Leaders' judgment and coaching.

next.ja: S5：複数業態で改善を定着させ、他の Chef にも再現できる仕組みをつくれること（S5 の位置付け）。
next.en: S5: make improvements take hold across several formats and build systems other Chefs can reproduce (the S5 position).

position.ja: Corporate Chef。会社全体の開発・原価・品質とKitchen Leader・後継者育成を主導。
position.en: Corporate Chef. Leads company-wide development, cost and quality, and the development of Kitchen Leaders and successors.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 84 行

summary.ja: 複数の業態で改善を定着させ、ほかの Chef も同じようにできる仕組みをつくる段階。
summary.en: Make improvements take hold across several formats and build systems other Chefs can follow.

scope.ja: 複数の業態（会社全体）
scope.en: Several formats (company-wide)

tasks.ja: レシピと品質の基準を整え、店のあいだのばらつきを減らす
tasks.en: Maintain recipe and quality standards and reduce variation between stores

tasks.ja: 仕入条件を比べ、売価・代替食材の選択肢を示す
tasks.en: Compare supplier terms and present price and substitute options

tasks.ja: 商品導入を店と連携して進め、販売後も改善する
tasks.en: Roll out products with the stores and keep improving after launch

develop.ja: Kitchen Leader の判断力・指導力を育てる。
develop.en: Develop Kitchen Leaders' judgment and coaching.

next.ja: S6：Corporate Chef を 2 名以上まとめ、全社成果と後継者育成を担えること（S6 の位置付け）。
next.en: S6: lead two or more Corporate Chefs and take on company-wide results and successor development (the S6 position).

position.ja: 高度なCorporate Chef。複数業態で改善を定着させ、他Chefにも再現できる仕組みをつくる。
position.en: Senior Corporate Chef. Makes improvements take hold across several formats and builds systems other Chefs can reproduce.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 85 行

summary.ja: Corporate Chef をまとめ、会社全体の食の成果と後継者の育成に責任を持つ段階。
summary.en: Lead the Corporate Chefs and own company-wide food results and successor development.

scope.ja: 会社全体（Corporate Chef 2 名以上をまとめる）
scope.en: Company-wide (leading two or more Corporate Chefs)

tasks.ja: 会社全体の商品と原価改善の方向を決め、続けて検証する
tasks.en: Set the direction for company products and cost improvement and keep verifying

tasks.ja: 衛生と品質の基準を会社全体で保つ
tasks.en: Keep hygiene and quality standards across the company

develop.ja: 次の Chef と Kitchen Leader を育てる。
develop.en: Develop the next Chefs and Kitchen Leaders.

position.ja: Corporate Chefを2名以上まとめ、各責任範囲を通じて全社成果と後継者育成を担う。
position.en: Leads two or more Corporate Chefs and, through their areas, is responsible for company-wide results and successor development.
position.src: 配点・基準点案 86 行

duty.ja: 担当の仕込み・調理の完結
味・分量・盛付の再現と品質のずれの予防
duty.en: Reproducing taste, portion, plating and preventing drift

note.ja: 範囲：S3 は店・S4 以上は会社全体
note.en: Scope: S3 the store; S4 and up the company

duty.ja: 温度・保管・アレルギー・衛生事故への備え
duty.en: Temperature, storage, allergies and incident readiness

notes.ja: 2点の担当範囲は等級と役割で広がる。異なる等級・職種の総合点で能力の上下を直接比較しない。上位等級では、以前に習得した基本能力も維持していることを確認する。
notes.en: The scope of a 2 widens with grade and role. Do not compare ability directly by total scores across grades or jobs. At higher grades, confirm that earlier basic skills are kept.
notes.src: 配点・基準点案 8 行

notes.ja: 昇格先の責任範囲・必須実務は別に確認する。現在の担当機会がなく非該当となった項目を未達と決めつけず、実務機会を設けて確認する。現在等級の高得点だけで自動昇格しない。
notes.en: The next grade's responsibilities and required work are checked separately. Items not applicable because there was no chance are not treated as failures; a chance is made to check them. A high score in the current grade alone does not promote automatically.
notes.src: 配点・基準点案 9 行

notes.ja: G3・S3は日常の業務・技術指導と習得確認を評価。リーダー・後継者育成を必須とするのはG4・S4以上。Sの専門指導は人事権を自動で含まず、採用・配置・勤怠評価などの管理責任はGの役割として別途明示する。
notes.en: G3 and S3 are evaluated on day-to-day work and technical coaching and mastery checks. Developing leaders and successors is required from G4 and S4. S specialist coaching does not automatically include HR authority; management responsibilities such as hiring, placement and attendance evaluation are stated separately as G roles.
notes.src: 配点・基準点案 87 行

notes.ja: 基本業務の配点が下がるのは責任配分の変化。必要能力は下げない。G5・G6は日々の実務の速度を主に競うのではなく、管轄の品質・是正・教育が維持される仕組みを確認する。
notes.en: Basic work gets a lower weight because responsibility shifts, not because the needed skills go down. For G5 and G6, check the systems that keep quality, correction and training in place, rather than daily speed.
notes.src: 配点・基準点案 37 行
